user_story: As a cashier, I want to create and edit products so prices and barcodes are accurate.
As a cashier, I want to maintain stock and deactivate unavailable products.
As a cashier, I want to add and remove cart items before payment.
As a cashier, I want an exact running total so I can state the amount due.
As a cashier, I want to record sufficient cash to complete the purchase.
As a cashier, I want the correct change displayed.
As a customer, I want a receipt preserving the original purchase details.
As a cashier, I want to review completed transactions.
As a cashier, I want to find the receipt before accepting a return.
As a customer, I want refunds calculated using the original price.
As a cashier, I want accepted returned units restored to stock.
As a cashier, I want invalid transactions rejected with English messages.
As a developer, I want repeatable normal, exceptional and concurrency tests.
As a developer, I want real MySQL integration and table evidence.
As a student, I want genuine browser and database evidence.
As a student, I want preserved Git branches and a confirmed remote repository.
As a student, I want two complete source-mapped quizzes.
As a student, I want an editable report tied to actual evidence.
